Author:     Evandro Baginski <ebaginski@thunderbird.net>

    Bug 2045127 - Override base image ENTRYPOINT in tb-flatpak Docker image. DONTBUILD r=sking
    
    
    The tb-flatpak Dockerfile builds on a base image whose own ENTRYPOINT invokes the linter tool. Adding ENTRYPOINT [] clears it so the image's CMD (and Taskcluster-provided commands) run as intended instead of being passed as arguments to the linter.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D307144

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
index 33a55be60da..a41e0a41bcd 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
@@ -27,5 +27,8 @@ RUN /scripts/make_venv.sh /scripts/fluent_requirements.txt
 RUN ["gcc", "-Wall", "-shared", "-o", "/scripts/close_range.so", "/scripts/close_range.c"]
 ENV LD_PRELOAD /scripts/close_range.so
 
+# Override the base image's own ENTRYPOINT (the linter tool itself)
+ENTRYPOINT []
+
 # Set a default command useful for debugging
 CMD ["/bin/bash", "--login"]
title: Bug 2045127 - Override base image ENTRYPOINT in tb-flatpak Docker image. DONTBUILD r=sking
